name: PF-4455242
summary: PF-04455242 is an experimental κ-opioid receptor (KOR) antagonist which was under development by Pfizer for the treatment of bipolar depression but was never marketed. Its development was discontinued in early clinical trials. It is taken by mouth.

uses.text: PF-04455242 is an experimental κ-opioid receptor (KOR) antagonist which was under development by Pfizer for the treatment of bipolar depression but was never marketed. Its development was discontinued in early clinical trials.

fact.en: Its development was stopped after signs of toxicity appeared in animal studies, which is where most drug candidates end.
fact.zh: 它在動物實驗中出現毒性徵象後研發中止，而大多數候選藥物正是在這個階段終止的。
